title: Combination of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers on One Ticket
content:
**Rule 1 — number of credits.** Several Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers may pay for the same ticket, up to 5 credits per ticket. The count for a ticket is the number of distinct credits with a redemption entry for that ticket, less those whose redemption was reversed, taken over the period from the ticket's first redemption to the moment of the new redemption.

**Rule 2 — which credits combine.** Only credits whose instrument may be combined with other credits may be combined on a ticket. A credit whose instrument may not be combined must be the only credit on the ticket.

**Rule 3 — order of application.** Unless the customer names the credits and the order, credits are applied in order of earliest expiry date first and, for equal expiry dates, lowest remaining value first. Each credit draws as much of the eligible amount as it holds.

**Rule 4 — exclusions.** Credits never combine with an award or miles-plus-cash payment on the same ticket. A credit is never applied to another customer's credit and is never converted into miles.

**Rule 5 — eligible amount.** The eligible amount a credit may pay is the base fare, plus the taxes where the instrument may pay taxes, plus seat and upgrade fees where the instrument may pay seat and upgrade fees. Bag fees are never payable with credit value.

## Count of credits on a ticket, illustrated (hypothetical)

| Credits with a redemption for the ticket | Reversed | Count | A further credit may be added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0 | 4 | Yes, as the 5th |
| 5 | 0 | 5 | No |
| 5 | 1 | 4 | Yes |

## Order of application, worked through (hypothetical)

Take two credits of an instrument that may pay taxes and may be combined, and a ticket with a base fare of 250.00 and taxes of 50.00 US dollars, so the eligible amount is 300.00. The customer names no order.

- *Different expiry dates.* Credit A holds 120.00 and expires on 10 January 2027; credit B holds 400.00 and expires on 30 November 2026. B expires first and draws the full 300.00. A is not used.
- *Equal expiry dates.* Credit A holds 80.00 and credit B holds 150.00, and both expire on the same day. The ticket's eligible amount is 200.00. A has the lower remaining value, so it is applied first and draws 80.00, and B then draws 120.00.

Where the customer names the credits and the order, that order applies.
